models.title: DTH-PHC overlay 0.1.0-draft.1
models.description: The dth-phc overlay on the smart-ra (DPI-H RA) ArchiMate model 0.3.0-draft.1: the person-centred point of service (PCPOSS) view and the shared DTH roles it uses. Elements tagged overlay:base copy a smart-ra element and name it by IRI; elements tagged overlay:owner=dth-phc are this DTH's own (dth-phc#8).
